artifact_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2G - Scientific Evaluation Preregistration

primary_endpoint.metric: Realized Maximum Drawdown (MDD) during market stress
primary_endpoint.formal_hypothesis: H1: MDD(Candidate D2) <= MDD(Frozen E0) - 0.0500 conditional on benchmark SPY experiencing a peak-to-trough drawdown >= 10.0%.
primary_endpoint.test_type: One-sided paired hypothesis test with bootstrap confidence interval

sample_size_and_horizon.stress_adequacy_condition: At least 1 market drawdown >= 10.0% in benchmark SPY must occur during the evaluation window to evaluate the primary endpoint.
sample_size_and_horizon.underpowered_outcome_rule: If the 252-session prospective window experiences only calm bull markets (SPY max drawdown < 10%), the drawdown superiority test is formally declared INCONCLUSIVE due to lack of market stress, preventing false certification.

statistical_inference_framework.standard_error_estimation: Newey-West Heteroskedasticity and Autocorrelation Consistent (HAC) estimator with lag L = floor(4 * (T / 100)^(2/9))
statistical_inference_framework.interim_monitoring_control: If interim quarterly reviews are conducted at 63, 126, 189, and 252 sessions, an O'Brien-Fleming alpha-spending boundary is applied to preserve family-wise error rate alpha = 0.05 (critical z-values: 4.048, 2.862, 2.337, 2.024).
statistical_inference_framework.peeking_policy: NO hyperparameter adjustment or code modification is permitted based on interim reviews.

stopping_and_escalation_criteria.catastrophic_safety_stop: If either strategy breaches 40.0% peak-to-trough drawdown, evaluation is paused for immediate human audit.
stopping_and_escalation_criteria.balance_sheet_fault_stop: Any invariant breach halts evaluation instantly.
stopping_and_escalation_criteria.live_transition_prohibition: A successful forward paper evaluation does NOT constitute authorization for live capital trading. Human repository owner review and broker risk clearance remain strictly required.
